title: An antimicrobial peptide as a potential therapy for bacterial pneumonia that alleviates antimicrobial resistance.

materials_exhausted.note: All paper-local structured materials relevant to worker-2/4/6 blockers were reopened; image-only exact figure cells without structured local support are preserved as nonblocking cautions.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review repaired the missing activity layer, reconciled linked APD6/DBAASP rows against source locators, and replaced the framework-test final with source-reviewed accepted-with-cautions adjudication. Remaining unmatched figure-image cells are preserved as database/source cautions rather than fabricated values.
summary: AMP 1003 is curated as an all-D synthetic (WRK)4 peptide with source-supported MIC, killing, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, biofilm, and bounded mechanism evidence. The paper is publication-grade with cautions for database rows whose exact figure-panel values are not locally structured.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Added primary-source activity/toxicity rows from main text methods/results and source-data workbook sheets; no database-only activity row is promoted without a source locator.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: Literature links and selected DBAASP/APD assay rows are source-verified where XML/text/source-data locators support them; exact database values that remain image-only or row-ambiguous are kept as source_conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: Closed the framework-test rework ticket after source review and strict gate repair; final status is accepted_with_cautions, not accepted_clean.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism_layer: Worker-6 final mechanism record now separates direct assay-backed membrane/non-membrane evidence from supportive transcriptomic context.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some linked DBAASP/APD rows contain exact values or labels not recoverable from structured XML/source-data rows; they remain source_conflict/database-only instead of source_verified.
Primary NXML has no table-wraps and local structured source data lacks exact Fig. 1c/d and Fig. 3a/b matrices; this does not block because source-supported rows and ranges were retained.
The paper is publication-grade for obtainable local material, but not a clean no-caution acceptance.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Primary NXML has zero table-wrap elements; the Source Data workbook contains many figure panels but not structured Fig. 1c/d MIC matrices or Fig. 3a/b FICI matrices, and local OCR/image libraries were unavailable in this runtime. Exact image-panel cells therefore remain database-source conflicts unless supported by primary text ranges or source-data sheets.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact per-isolate MIC cells and per-antibiotic FICI cells that lack structured local support are retained as source_conflict/database-only cautions; supported MIC ranges, toxicity, killing, and biofilm rows are extracted.
